target_customer: Small merchants and shop owners in India, then lending customers
problem: Small businesses record customer credit and debit in paper ledgers, losing track of dues and lacking records to access credit.
business_model: Free bookkeeping app that monetizes through lending and financial services
product_category: Fintech digital ledger and SME lending

founders.name: Jaideep Poonia
founders.background_notes: Named as founder in KrAsia 2020 and YourStory; not listed on YC page.

competitors.name: OkCredit
competitors.what: Digital credit ledger app for small merchants in India, launched 2017

competitors.name: Vyapar
competitors.what: Mobile business accounting software for small businesses, founded 2017

technical_complexity.rationale: A mobile ledger app is straightforward; scale across 11 languages and later lending integrations added engineering.

defensibility.rationale: Merchants keep their ledger data in the app, but OkCredit, Vyapar and later Google and BharatPe offered close substitutes.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Google announced a business payments and web presence service in 2019 per Inventiva; competitors OkCredit laid off staff and Khatabook also cut jobs in 2023 but no incumbent absorbed it.

market_need_then: India has around 60 million small shops using paper ledgers, per a 2020s explainer; unpaid credit is a common pain and Khatabook claimed 5 million merchants by October 2019.

identity.mascot_or_character: MS Dhoni playing comic characters in ads (Tomorrow Swamy, Sharmile Sharmaji, Techno Tawde)

branding.brand_signature: MS Dhoni as brand ambassador and investor since March 2020
branding.community_and_virality: Six week #DhandeKaDoctor campaign in five languages (2021) and IPL ad spots drew trade press coverage.

brand_strength.rationale: Celebrity backed, multilingual campaigns and a category leading ledger app in India; effect on revenue not measured in sources.

pivots.why: Shut down MyStore to focus on core products (YourStory)

outcome_analysis: Khatabook grew from a YC Summer 2018 ledger app to 5 million merchants by late 2019 and raised four rounds up to a $100 million Series C in 2021 at a valuation near $600 million, helped by a Dhoni led brand. Funding conditions tightened later, with layoffs of about 40 people in September 2023 and a profitability push; FY24 revenue was Rs 102.7 crore. It is active, with the lending business still to prove itself.
notes: Series C amount, date and investors come from search snippets (AVCJ, YourStory, Business Standard, DTNext); the YourStory page itself returned 403 on fetch. Series C valuation reported as near or above $600M but not recorded as post_money because the exact figure was not read in an opened source. The roughly $4M earlier round is derived from Inventiva's $29M total after the $25M Series A. Series B valuation reported only in snippets ($250M to $300M) and not recorded. Competitor sources are dated October 2019, about a year after the batch, which is later than preferred; OkCredit and Vyapar both launched in 2017 per later sources. Inc42 says Khatabook was founded by Vaibhav Kalpe and acquired by Kyte Technologies in 2018; this conflicts with YourStory and is unverified. YC says founded 2019; YourStory says December 2018. khatabook.com fetch returned only nav labels. Name origin not found.
